The child is surrounded by other baby items, including a stack of white cloth diapers to the left and a container of wipes or cream to the right. An adult's arm is visible in the background, appearing to dress or attend to the child.

The edge of the blue mat near the bottom right seems to warp slightly inconsistently with the floor perspective, though this could also be due to the mat being flexible.
